Name: BVG Animal Overhaul
Author: i24KittyKat
Description:
[size=4]Two versions of this mod are available one that uses the Producer Framework Mod [u](for basic use and play)[/u] and one that uses Extra Machine Configs mod [u](for use with Cornucopia - Artisan Machines)[/u] both are compatible with other mods but the PFM version will not have Cornucopia exclusive Items[/size]

[center][size=5][b]BVG Overhaul[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url] required)
[*] More crops are now available
[*] More skin variants are available
[*] New animal -Dairy Sheep along with BVG variants and products
[*] Now has and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] addon with variant meats (working on variant meat recipes as well)
[*] Some vanilla items have been edited to match my mod for continuity (Bread, Eggs, Mayo) if you have any mods that alter the same assets it may mess with the images in some instances
[*][i]More coming soon[/i]
[/list]
[size=5][center][b]Installation[/b][/center][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url]) depending on which version you want
[*](OPTIONAL) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for animal skin configuration
[*]Unzip the main file into the mod folder
[*]Enjoy playing
[/list]

[center]Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/67968777]siamece[/url] for allowing the use of assets for this mod
Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ZoeyHoshi]ZoeyHoshi[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou]mrtaiyou[/url] for seedbags and sapling asset use permissions
To [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Syanide23]Syanide23[/url] for Forage Trees use permission
and to the Cornucopia team and Mizu[/center]
